Uses

Last reviewed November 5, 2026

This is a small collection of the hardware and software I use. It covers my desk setup, 3D printers, editors, terminal, frameworks, and everyday applications. I mostly use the default apps, with a few other tools in the mix. I'll update this page as my setup changes.

Desk setup

My desk setup includes a Mac mini with an Apple M4 chip and 16 GB of memory. I use two Dell P2722HE displays and a Mistel Barocco split keyboard. My mouse is a Logitech MX Master 3S. I also use a 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Wireless.

I still prefer writing on paper with a pencil or a pen. When I use a pen, I like a Uni-ball gel roller for the smooth glide.

3D printers

I have a Creality K1 Max, a Creality CR-10 Mini, and a Creality CR-10S. I also have three FLSUN QQ-S Pro delta printers.

Software

I use Zed, Vim and IntelliJ for editing and development. My terminal setup includes Oh My Zsh and custom dotfiles. For RSS feeds on iOS, I use Reeder Classic. Outside those tools, I mostly use the default applications.

I build this site with React and Next.js, and I style it with Tailwind CSS. The build runs on Node.js, and the published pages are static HTML and CSS. I host those pages on AWS S3 and CloudFront.
